question:
Refer to the exhibit. An engineer must create a script that downloads the POAP personality tarball file from an FTP server that is exposed in the SERVER environmental variable. The personality file to be downloaded is named with the hostname of the switch and the tar extension. The default method of downloading the file must be SCP. Which code snippet completes the script?
from poap.personality import POAPPersonality
import os

______

username = os.environ['USERNAME'] if 'USERNAME' in os.environ else "root"
password = os.environ['PASSWORD']
server = os.environ['SERVER']
vrf = os.environ['POAP_VRF'] if 'POAP_VRF' in os.environ else "default"

personality = POAPPersonality(
  download_path,
  personality_tarball,
  protocol,
  username,
  password,
  server,
  vrf
)

personality.get_personality()
personality.apply_personality()
options:
download_path = "/var/lib/tftpboot"
hostname = os.system('show hostname')
personality_tarball = os.path.join(download_path, f'{hostname}.tar')
protocol = os.environ['PROTOCOL']

download_path = "/var/lib/tftpboot"
hostname = os.system('show hostname')
personality_tarball = os.path.join("/tmp", f'{hostname}.tar')
protocol = os.environ['PROTOCOL'] if 'PROTOCOL' in os.environ else "scp"

download_path = "/var/lib/tftpboot"
hostname = os.system('vsh -c "show hostname"')
personality_tarball = os.path.join("/tmp", f'{hostname}.tar')
protocol = os.environ['PROTOCOL'] if 'PROTOCOL'

download_path = "/var/lib/tftpboot"
hostname = os.system('vsh -c "show hostname"')
personality_tarball = os.path.join(download_path, f'{hostname}.tar')
protocol = os.environ['PROTOCOL'] if 'PROTOCOL' in os.environ else "scp"
theory: Because the task requires SCP as the default transfer protocol and the tarball must be fetched to the same download_path later passed into POAPPersonality(), the script has to build personality_tarball with os.path.join(download_path, ...) — not a separately hardcoded /tmp path — and set protocol = os.environ['PROTOCOL'] if 'PROTOCOL' in os.environ else "scp" so it only falls back to scp when the operator hasn't overridden it. The hostname must also be queried through the NX-OS CLI via 'vsh -c "show hostname"' rather than a plain shell command that has no notion of the switch's identity. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 17 — Evaluate Automation and Orchestration Technologies)
